head: 5d1ebbb54fcf11907fa0e3a619a9e9ed5d4d35a4
title: Usage reset saves its snapshot but leaves the balance snapshots taken after the reset time valid

bugs.note: A reset at time T rolls the grants over and writes a snapshot at T, but snapshots already stored after T were computed without the reset. Grant creation and voiding invalidate snapshots after their effective time; the reset does not. A later balance query starts from such a stale snapshot, so usage before the reset is counted again and grant balances after a backdated reset are wrong.
